title: Characterizing Cultural Localization in AI-Generated Stories

bias_targets.methodology: Generating stories for 193 cultural identities (operationalized as nationalities), extracting distinguishing lexical cultural markers using Normalized Pointwise Mutual Information (NPMI), measuring the similarity of the remaining culturally-agnostic templates, and evaluating the extracted markers for stereotype precision and offensiveness using the SeeGULL dataset.

Prompting models to write stories for specific nationalities and analyzing the outputs to determine if narrative structures homogenize across nationalities when specific nationality markers (e.g., names, locations) are removed.
